scenario: `emit X logical` correctness depends on CLIPS no-op dedup per LLOG.6.1 — re-emitting the same logical fact (same slot values) is a no-op; the existing justification is extended, not duplicated. Pin: rule fires twice for two trigger asserts; Hit emitted twice but only one Hit fact exists (dedup). Strict: both firings carry an action_emit, and only the first carries a fact_assert. The second emit is the no-op, so the stream holds the two Triggers' fact_asserts and one Hit's. A subsequence match cannot see a second Hit fact_assert, which is the duplication the vector names.
rules_ds:
schema Trigger scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    kind: String mutable

schema Hit scope logical:
    dummy: Int key

rule r:
    Trigger t where t.kind == "motion"
->
    emit Hit logical dummy: 0
